purpose: Connect independently evolving GlacierEQ systems through live discovery and composition. This file is a bootstrap protocol, not a frozen topology or source of project truth.
prime_rule: DISCOVER CURRENT SOURCE STATE AT USE TIME. DO NOT FREEZE A FAST-MOVING PROJECT INTO COPIED PAPERWORK.

resolution.after_material_mutation: rediscover affected peers before the next routing decision

algorithm: Resolve each relevant peer from its live repository head and repo-owned discovery surfaces.
Build a task-scoped capability graph from what exists now; do not reuse a stale global role map.
Compose only the peers and capabilities useful to the objective.
Execute through the strongest current implementation and interface.
Verify against the source system that actually changed.
Invalidate affected task-scoped discovery state after mutation and rediscover before subsequent routing.
Persist provenance, receipts, and continuation pointers; do not persist a frozen description as controlling truth.
anti_freeze: No central file owns another repository's role, maturity, capability count, or end state.
No copied README, registry summary, generated map, or capability list outranks the current source repository.
A peer may evolve, split, add capabilities, replace interfaces, or supersede its own prior state without updating a central narrative first.
Integration follows interfaces and live discovery, not permanent hierarchy.
There is no architectural finish line: successful integration must remain evolvable.
durable_state: source revision used for a decision
